    "If model consistently overestimates prices in early days of a new trend, apply a 3–5% downward bias to correct for lag.",
    "In low-sentiment periods (all 0.00), model often overestimates; apply a 2–5% downward correction to align with mean reversion.",
    "If sentiment turns positive (e.g., 0.50) after a downtrend, model may lag; adjust forecast upward by 3–7% to capture momentum.",
    "Avoid extreme forecasts (e.g., >75% above recent high or <50% below recent low) unless sentiment confirms strong breakout."
